title: A Short Adventure Time Story That Became Very Big
summary:
Some cartoon bad guys are just silly. The Ice King is different: funny, sad, and a little scary all at once.

A new look back at Adventure Time calls one episode from 13 years ago a masterpiece. It is "Simon & Marcy," season 5, episode 14, ten minutes long.

At first, the Ice King seemed simple. He lived with his penguins, used ice powers, and tried to catch princesses. Finn and Jake usually stopped him.

Then, in season 4, episode 25, "Remember Me," Marceline, the vampire queen, calls him Simon for the first time. That hints at a past we had not seen.

"Simon & Marcy" shows part of that past. It is a flashback set almost 1,000 years before the story. After the Mushroom War changed Earth into Ooo, Simon travels through a ruined city with Marcy, and they look after each other.

His magic crown gives him ice powers but makes thinking hard. Singing the Cheers theme seems to help. The episode explains Simon and Marceline and led to more stories across nearly 300 episodes and a spinoff.
why_it_matters: Great stories can hide a sad past inside a funny character, and noticing that makes cartoons even more fun to watch.
